class.name: LLMChat
class.brief_description: Async chat completion using in-process llama.cpp inference.
class.description: Runs chat completion on a worker thread. Emits [signal token_generated] for each token as it is produced (streaming) and [signal response_received] when the full response is ready. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var chat = LLMChat.new() chat.setup(model, ctx) chat.max_tokens = 256 chat.enable_thinking = false chat.token_generated.connect(func(tok): print(tok)) chat.response_received.connect(func(text): print("Done:", text)) chat.complete([{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: complete
method.description: Starts an async chat completion. [param messages] is an [Array] of [Dictionary] with [code]role[/code] ([code]"system"[/code], [code]"user"[/code], [code]"assistant"[/code]) and [code]content[/code] keys. Emits [signal token_generated] for each token, then [signal response_received] when done. Emits [signal inference_failed] on error. Only one request may be in flight at a time — check [method is_busy] first.

method.name: is_busy
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a completion request is currently running.

method.name: setup
method.description: Associates this chat instance with a loaded [LLMModel] and an initialized [LLMContext]. Must be called before [method complete].

members.member: When [code]true[/code], includes the model's chain-of-thought reasoning in the output (Qwen3.5 thinking mode). The reasoning content appears before the final answer in the response.
Maximum number of tokens to generate per completion.
Penalty applied to recently generated tokens to reduce repetition.
Sampling temperature. Higher values produce more random outputs.
Top-K sampling — number of top tokens to sample from.

signal.name: inference_failed
signal.description: Emitted if inference fails. [param error] contains the error message.

signal.name: response_received
signal.description: Emitted when the full response is ready. [param text] contains the complete generated text.

signal.name: token_generated
signal.description: Emitted for each token as it is generated. Use this for streaming output.
